scope: Exploratory endpoint selection on six already-used source banks; not a fresh confirmatory result. No solver inference.
noise: For bank s, independent potential labels use NumPy2.3.4 RNG20265000+s; every row draws81Bernoulli(.01)flips then81uniform offsets1..8, noisy=(clean+flip*offset)%9. Policies see only their queried noisy labels; common potential values pair the arms.
ties: NumPy2.3.4 default_rng(20261125+s), one shared81permutation per row. All three masks finalize before any current noisy label is exposed.
gate: E-process arms irreversibly exclude at first exact rational LR>=324000; naive arm at first observed equality. All arms retain log-LRpaths and first crossings. Fixed exponential exposure factor8/9, no eta/q1 tuning.
budget: CPU only; exactly six old banks,three arms,3000rows. No extensions or fitting to later fresh-bank outcomes.
